verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the security page: workspace admins can disable all personal data storage so Parahelp does not retain it. That is a data-retention control adjacent to privacy, not a documented opt-out from telemetry or usage tracking. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out, documentation of what usage data is collected, per-user (not just admin) controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
